aboutBody: I'm a software developer with 3+ years of experience shipping production web and mobile applications end to end, currently Senior Backend Developer at Holora Performance in Doha.

My work spans an unusually wide range of constraints: a cross-platform DNS security ecosystem, an offline-first desktop ERP that runs with no hosted server, multi-tenant commerce and metadata-driven enterprise platforms, and AI systems — OCR, computer vision and meeting intelligence — that I train and serve entirely on my own infrastructure with no third-party inference API.

Before Holora I spent three years at Techynova delivering five live client platforms for UK and Qatar businesses as the primary or sole engineer — owning architecture, backend, frontend, deployment, security and direct English-language client communication.

I'm comfortable as the sole technical owner of a product, and I care most about the decisions underneath the software: why a Bloom filter sits before the trie, why the network can disappear and the app keeps working, why the AI stays on owned hardware.
